artifact_reasoning: The image exhibits moderate artifacts. The primary issue is the structural ambiguity in the hockey players' equipment (specifically the goalie), where sticks and pads appear fused or geometrically inconsistent (Router severity 2.5). The ice texture is overly smooth/plastic (Router severity 1.5). While the Perceptual Auditor reported low compression artifacts, the overall visual fidelity is compromised by what appears to be AI-generated smoothing and lack of high-frequency detail typical of real sports photography. The presence of two identical-looking pucks suggests minor object duplication artifacts.
